messages:
sam: Heads-up — a new user hit a JSON parse error when using the samplekit sampleapp in json-mode + fncall. Repro below, blocking onboarding.

maria: Ugh, can you paste the exact output and which SDK/version?

dan: Sometimes the retry/auth helper will mutate the tool output on the retry path. Could be parity between node/py stubs.

sam: Repro (user's minimal snippet):
```js
// node sampleapp repro (trimmed)
const res = await client.responses.create({
  input: [{ role: 'user', content: 'call tool X' }],
  json_mode: true,
  handle_tools: true,
});
console.log(res.output);
// printed value: "{\"result\": [\"ok\"]}"
```

sam: So their code then does JSON.parse(res.output) and it throws "Unexpected token " in JSON at position 0" because the SDK returned a stringified JSON wrapped in quotes.

maria: Which exact SDK? node or python?
sam: Node 0.12.0 reported by the user. They tried a quick py-run and got an array-inside-object shape instead.
dan: Yeah that smells like the client-side helper that sanitizes tool outputs for retries is stringifying on the error+retry path. Node and Python helpers diverged a bit during the recent auth-backoff refactor.
maria: Quick workaround for now: disable client retry or set raw_response: true if available, then parse manually. Does that get them unblocked?
sam: Disabling retry fixed it in the repro — the direct response returns an object. So retry + auth backoff path = double-stringify.
qa-bot: /ticket created: DX-1234 "sampleapp json_mode fncall retry double-stringify"
dan: I'll open a small patch to stop stringify-on-retry and add a unit for fncall schema validation. Plan: 1) detect if output is a quoted JSON string and unquote before schema validation, 2) add opt-in json_mode_strict flag so we don't silently coerce older apps.
maria: Can we also add an automated sampleapp integration test in the bootcamp that injects transient auth failures so CI runs the exact retry path? That would've caught this early.
dan: Good call — will add a CI job that flips a 5% auth error flag for the tool mock.
ci-bot: canary deploy scheduled by dan for patch branch at 18:00 UTC — /canary id: c-789
dan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/888 — contains patch + tests + short doc note for quickstart.
sam: Thanks — I'll paste this into the onboarding checklist and reach out to the affected signups.
maria: Also add a short FAQ blurb: "If you see JSON parse errors from fncall outputs, try disabling client retry or set json_mode_strict=false while we roll the patch."
dan: Will do. Planning to cut a minor release after canary validation.
ci-bot: canary passed on canary-3 (no regressions)
sam: :tada: thanks team, this unblocks at least three new signups.
maria: :thumbsup:
